new_value: Devin Fusion launched in preview June 29, 2026; Cognition claims a 35% cost cut (41% with its Fable 5 model) at frontier-level quality on its own FrontierCode benchmark.
headline: Cognition launches Devin Fusion, claims 35% lower cost at frontier quality
so_what: Cognition now has a direct answer to the cost objection and fresh proof for its model-agnostic pitch, both aimed at Cursor. Reps should expect 'Devin is 35% cheaper now' in deals and answer that the figure is a preview on Cognition's own benchmark, not a shipped price cut.
